newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands may take Placer to court.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands may take Placer to court.

text.p: Lawyers for Highlands Gold Ltd said on Friday the company would take legal action in Australia and Papua New Guinea on Monday if hostile bidder Placer Dome Inc did not amend alleged defects in its offer document.

Law firm Allens Arthur Robinson said in a letter to Placer Dome that it should release all information it had to Highlands shareholders including information about the Porgera gold mine joint venture in Papua New Guinea in which each company has a 25 percent stake and for which Placer is the operator.
Highlands has said the 75 cent per share offer by Placer is inadequate. Placer already has 33 percent of Highlands.

The law firm said Highlands wanted its shareholders to have access to other information such as the intentions of Placer and its Singapore subsidiary, which is the bidding vehicle, towards the Highlands business and any major changes that might be planned.

"We are further instructed by our client that, if your client's undertakings.... are not received by 10.00 a.m. (Papua New Guinea time) on Monday, 16 December 1996, it is our client's intention to institute legal proceedings in the courts of Papua New Guinea and Australia in order to protect the interests of its shareholders who are resident in each of those countries," the law firm said in a letter to Placer Singapore's law firm Allens Arthur Robinson.
